result:
I would make it impossible for people to dehumanize one another.

If that one thing changed, many other evils would lose their footing: cruelty, exploitation, indifference to suffering, and large-scale violence would become much harder to justify. Not because everyone would suddenly agree, but because seeing another person as less than human is the doorway through which so much harm enters.
